text: On it: the balancers in middleware/proxy.go panic when there are no targets (index out of range / divide by zero), and the Proxy middleware doesn't guard against a nil target. A subagent is fixing it now; I'll confirm once the fix is verified against the full test suite.
Got it — second bug (router.go, non-routable path handling) is now assigned to a subagent as well. Both fixes are in progress; I'll report as soon as each is verified.
Third bug (context.go Scheme()/X-Forwarded-Proto validation) assigned. Three fixes now in flight; I'll report each as it's verified.
Fourth bug (bind.go, bindDataToMap with map[string][]string) assigned. Four fixes in flight now; reports coming as they verify.

Bug #1 fixed and verified in middleware/proxy.go:
- randomBalancer.Next / roundRobinBalancer.Next now return nil instead of panicking (Intn on empty / divide-by-zero) when the balancer has no targets.
- Proxy middleware guards a nil target and returns 502 Bad Gateway instead of dereferencing nil.
- Also fixed the unsynchronised read in AddTarget and the racy round-robin index (clean under -race).
Full `go test ./...` is green before and after, no pre-existing test touched.
Fifth bug (group.go, middleware leaking between two groups registered on the same path) assigned to a subagent. Still working through the earlier four.
Sixth bug (middleware/compress.go, empty gzip response) assigned. Six fixes in flight; I'll report each as it verifies.
